shard.name: Velocity
shard.description: Next-generation high-performance Minecraft proxy powered by PaperMC, designed with modern architecture and unmatched scalability.
shard.author: PaperMC & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Velocity Proxy Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" ] || [ "${VELOCITY_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Velocity version..."
    VELOCITY_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity | jq -r '.versions[-1]')
fi

echo "Target Velocity version: ${VELOCITY_VERSION}"

if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest build number for ${VELOCITY_VERSION}..."
    BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -s https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds | jq -r '.builds[-1].build')
fi

echo "Target build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
JAR_NAME="velocity-${VELOCITY_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/${VELOCITY_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"

echo "Downloading Velocity from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Velocity installation complete!"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the executable jar file to run Velocity.
